messages:
mike: Heads-up: CI started failing a bunch of SAST/DAST runs after yesterday's RBAC tidy. Seeing KMS AccessDenied on artifact unwraps and some DAST 401s. Blocking a release.
sec-bot: automated alert: `scan-coordinator` failures=54 fail_rate=0.21 increased=+15% recent_error=\"KMS:AccessDenied\" run: https://ci.internal/runs/15432
zoe: That's likely the role-assume change from infra PR #421. The scanner now assumes `sec-scan-role` instead of using the old service account principal. KMS key policy might still reference the old principal.
harry: Sample log: ```2024-05-12T09:02:13Z scan ERROR unwrap artifact=gh-7777 error=AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::444444444:assumed-role/sec-scan-role/scanner is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444444444:key/cc33-dd44```
sophie: Quick plan: 1) open a soft-fail waiver so merges can proceed, 2) patch KMS key policy (staging first), 3) run decrypt smoke tests, 4) re-run a subset of failing jobs, 5) tune SAST rule noise if needed.
infra-oncall: Created waiver WAIV-20240512-09: scan-suite soft-fail for 2h. Keep me updated to extend.
tom: I'll prepare a minimal key-policy patch to include `arn:aws:iam::444444444:role/sec-scan-role` and `arn:aws:sts::444444444:assumed-role/sec-scan-role/*`. Who can apply in staging?
zoe: I can apply in staging. Recommend also adding a quick smoke test command to the runbook. Example: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/cc33-dd44 --profile staging-scan`
harry: Also seeing many false positives from a recent SAST rule catching long hex sequences in generated code (`rule: long-hex-literal`). We should whitelist `gen/**` and lower severity. I'll open a config PR.
sophie: Action items (owners): - create soft-fail waiver (infra-oncall) - patch key policy in staging (zoe) - run decrypt smoke (zoe) - prod rollout after staging validation (tom) - open SAST config PR for generated-code whitelist (harry) - add a short KB entry to runbook about RBAC->KMS drift (mike)
sec-bot: incident created: id=INC-20240512-01 "scan-blocker: kms policy & rbac drift" link: https://inc.internal/INC-20240512-01
zoe: Staging key-policy patch applied. Decrypt smoke passed: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444444444:key/cc33-dd44 --profile staging-scan` -> OK.
tom: Rolling the policy to prod in 10m; will run decrypt against archived artifact once live.
harry: Opened PR for SAST suppression: https://git.internal/sast-config/pull/121 (whitelist gen/** + severity tweak).
zoe: Prod key-policy patched and decrypt smoke against archived artifact succeeded. Re-ran 10 failing pipelines: unwraps fixed, DAST 401s mostly unrelated token expiry.
mike: I'll add a new preflight check to the infra change template: when a role principal is modified, scan KMS key policies for references to the old principal and warn/fail. Will file infra task.
infra-oncall: Waiver will expire in 40m; scans returning to normal baseline. Extend if anything else pops.
sophie: I'll update the runbook with checklist and example commands including contact list for key policy owners. Include rollback steps: re-add inline SA policy or revert role-assume.
sec-bot: incident-note appended: root_cause="RBAC role-assume change left KMS key policy referencing removed principal" mitigation="key-policy update + CI waiver + heuristic tuning" id=INC-20240512-01
mike: Filing short postmortem and linking the infra-preflight ticket and SAST-heuristic PR. Thanks everyone for quick triage.
